# Kaya Hickin

> Three-for-three profitable founder. Co-founder & CTO of MyFutureSelf, an AI iOS app with 2,900+ active paid subscribers, 30,000+ downloads, a $115K+ annual run rate, 52% average monthly revenue growth, and a 4.7★ App Store rating from 1,032 verified reviews. Solo-engineered the iOS app, backend, and voice-AI stack end-to-end. AI-native shipper — 1.9M+ tracked lines of code across active repos, 6,000+ GitHub contributions in the last year, and 9B+ lifetime Codex tokens used. 20+ websites and 2 App Store apps shipped to date. Daily stack: Claude Code, Codex, Granola, Wispr Flow, 5 Ghostty tabs, and OpenClaw running while I sleep. Domain expertise in consumer AI, iOS, voice agents, and behavior-change products.

## Who I am

- **Role**: Co-founder & CTO at MyFutureSelf (50% equity). Technical founder.
- **Location**: Cleveland, OH.
- **Education**: Miami University, BA Marketing & Entrepreneurship (graduated May 2026). Valedictorian, Crestwood HS.
- **Contact**: kaya@successai.app
- **Born**: 2004 (age 22).
- **Looking for**: Backing for consumer AI work, technical co-founders, founder-friendly investors. Strong fit for **a16z Speedrun**, **Y Combinator**, and consumer-AI accelerators.

## Track record (3-for-3 profitable companies)

1. **MyFutureSelf** (Jan 2025–present, active) — AI iOS app delivering personalized future-self mentorship via a 90-day roadmap and a voice AI mentor. As CTO I solo-built iOS (Swift/SwiftUI), backend (Node.js, Firebase, Cloud Functions), and voice-AI stack (WebRTC, OpenAI Realtime). **Current traction: 30,000+ downloads, 2,900+ active paid subscribers, a $115K+ annual run rate, 52% average monthly revenue growth, 4.7★ App Store rating (1,032 reviews).** https://myfutureselfapp.com — https://apps.apple.com/us/app/myfutureself-achieve-success/id6745573360

2. **Appointra** (Jun 2024–May 2025, wound down to focus on MyFutureSelf) — AI-powered B2B outbound agency. I personally built the cold-email infrastructure: hundreds of domains, thousands of inboxes, full DNS/SPF/DKIM/automated warmup. **Scaled to $20K MRR in 3 months. Generated $2M+ in client pipeline. Closed a unicorn-exit founder, a 9-figure CEO, and an NYC AI startup serving Amazon, Google, and Apple.** https://appointra.net

3. **LeadBoost Pro** (Mar 2023–Jun 2024) — Started in my dorm room freshman year. Web development and growth marketing for small/underrepresented businesses. **Profitable from month one. $20K+ revenue. Website retainers still throw off ~$250 MRR in passive income today.** https://leadboost-pro.com

## Other shipped products

- **Dog AI** — iOS computer-vision app interpreting dog behavior. Weekend build, paying users. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dog-ai-dog-mood-detector/id6746574124

- AI-native development workflow built around **Claude Code** and **Codex** running daily.
- **Daily stack**: Claude Code + Codex (coding agents), Granola (meeting notes), Wispr Flow (voice-to-text), 5 tabs of Ghostty (terminal), and OpenClaw running autonomously while I sleep.
- Engineering stack:
  - iOS: Swift, SwiftUI, Core Data, StoreKit, WebRTC, RevenueCat, Superwall, TestFlight.
  - Web: TypeScript, Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Vercel.
  - Backend: Node.js, Firebase, Firestore, Cloud Functions, Supabase, Stripe, PostHog.
  - AI: OpenAI Responses API, Claude API, Realtime/Voice, Whisper, ElevenLabs.
  - Workflow: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Ghostty, Wispr Flow, Granola, Lovable, Replit.
